blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact.
  Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners.
  AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input.
  It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame.
  We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses $\sim$10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection.
  To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.
blocks.zh:
AI编码代理现在可以在几分钟内建立小型的可玩游戏,但结果通常看起来像程序员的艺术:灰色屏蔽,彩色几何原始,以及扁平的语义blobs. 我们介绍AnyGameRender, 一个视频到视频的基因渲染器, 将这种镜头变成高质量的视觉, 有人物,动作细节, 和效果。 在整个过程中,它保持了布局,摄像头,以及每个实体的位置和时间的完整.
我们的AnyGameRender 概括了特工们所建立的各种流派,例如塔楼防御,自动击球手,自上而下的幸存者,回合制战斗,Kart赛车,以及人群跑者.
AnyGameRender将纯视频作为其游戏状态输入,没有引擎G-buffers,每个对象类标签,或低波代理等复杂的表示. 灰色挡板,彩色原始,语义图,以及线框都作为输入工作.
它还保存实体函证:组数保持正确,实体出现在右框并消失.
我们执行AnyGameRender,由LORA微调MiniMax-H3 ref2va,一种33B参考视频条件的视频生成模型. 训练使用来自三个来源的$\sim$10k的配对剪辑: (一)来自GEAR输出的38款代理游戏的多流渲染数据,这是AI游戏制作工具; (二)来自Unreal Engine的双流渲染数据,有程序上控制的人群,计数变化,以及实体尺度; (三)真实的游戏剧情录制,通过3D盒检测重建的配对.
为了评价实体的函证,我们提出一个实体一级的基准,即59个搁置案件,有753个实体,与地面真相箱对照。 与基数模型相比,AnyGameRender更好地保存实体对应:时间匹配从50.9\%上升到62.9\%,错失的计数变化从34.7\%下降到21.3\%,幻觉或未触动的实体较少.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Coding agents and tools, such as GEAR [ 1 ] game-creation system, can now turn a one-paragraph prompt into a playable game in minutes, complete with game logic, physics, camera, win conditions, and working HUD [ 7 ] . What they cannot produce is good art. The output usually contains gray boxes, colored cylinders, and cones on flat-shaded ground. Human studios spend months replacing this kind of “programmer art” through modeling, texturing, and lighting.
Splitting a game into an engine that manages state and a generative model that renders pixels has quickly become a common idea. Concurrent systems such as CWM [ 8 ] , PWM [ 15 ] , Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 32 ] , StreamRender-H3 [ 29 ] , Marionette [ 26 ] , and SolarRenderer [ 33 ] all adopt it in some form. We do not argue for this setting. Instead, we build a rendering layer that is more general in what it accepts and more faithful in what it keeps.
blocks.zh:
编码代理和工具,如GEAR [1] 游戏创作系统,现在可以在几分钟内将一段提示转换成可玩游戏,完成游戏逻辑,物理,相机,赢条件,以及工作HUD [7]. 他们不能生产的就是好艺术。 输出物通常包含灰盒,彩色圆筒,以及平面阴影地面上的圆锥. 人类工作室花费数月时间,通过建模、纹理和照明来取代这种“程序员艺术”。
将游戏拆分为管理状态的引擎和使像素成像素的基因模型,很快成为一个常见的想法. CWM [8],PWM [15],Matrix-Game 4.0 [32],Strearender-H3 [29],Marionette [26],Solarrenderer [33]等并行系统均以某种形式采用. 我们不主张这种设置。 相反,我们构建了一个渲染层,在它所接受的事物中更加笼统,在它所保持的事物中更加忠实.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : AnyGameRenderer turns crude gameplay into polished game visuals. Top: one checkpoint handles diverse genres and input types, and renders one input in many styles. Insets show the crude input. Bottom: an agent writes the game and the engine outputs a blockout, which AnyGameRenderer renders into the final visuals. This allows style switching and skips modeling, texturing and animation.
blocks.zh: 图1: AnyGameRender将粗糙的游戏玩法转化为抛光游戏视觉. 顶部:一个检查站处理不同的流派和输入类型,并且使一个输入具有多种风格. Insets 显示粗糙的输入. Bottom:一个代理写游戏,引擎输出一个阻断,AnyGameRenderer将其制成最终的视觉. 这允许样式切换和跳过模型,纹理和动画.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , AnyGameRenderer takes a crude gameplay recording and a text prompt (optionally with a style anchor image), and outputs the same gameplay re-rendered in the prompted style, frame-aligned with the input. It adds characters, motion detail, and effects, while keeping the layout, camera, and every entity’s position and timing. This brings two practical benefits. A game can easily switch to a new visual style by changing only the prompt. It also makes vibe gaming faster, since a game only needs code and a blockout, without modeling, texturing or animation.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,AnyGameRenderer采用粗糙的游戏游戏录制和文字提示(可选带有样式主播图像),并输出相同的游戏播放器在提示样式中重发,帧与输入对齐. 它增加了人物,运动细节和效果,同时保持布局,镜头,以及每个实体的位置和时间. 这带来了两个实际好处。 游戏只需更改提示即可轻松切换到新的视觉风格. 这也使得气氛游戏更快,因为游戏只需要代码和屏蔽,而不需要建模,纹理或动画.

blocks.en: There are three properties that set AnyGameRenderer apart. (1) It generalizes across genres. Prior and concurrent works are demonstrated mainly on third-person, first-person, or driving footage, with limited coverage of the genres that agents actually produce. As illustrated in Figure 1 , AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres, including tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, crowd runners, arena survival, co-op games, and shooters. In addition, it accepts diverse input types, including gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, wireframes, and coarse mockup.
blocks.zh: 有三个属性将 AnyGameRender 分开. (1)它概括跨流派. 之前和同时期的作品主要在第三人称,第一人称,或驾驶镜头上展示,对特工实际制作的流派的报道有限. 如图1所示,AnyGameRender对各种流派进行了概括,包括塔楼防御、自动射击、自上而下的幸存者、回合制战斗、Kart赛、人群跑者、竞技场生存、合作游戏和射击手。 此外,它接受不同的输入类型,包括灰色阻塞,彩色原始,语义图,线框,粗制模具.

blocks.en: (2) It keeps entity correspondence. The hard part of game rendering is bookkeeping: twelve enemies become nine when three die; a reinforcement wave walks in at t = 4.2 t{=}4.2 s; a tiny far-away mob must not dissolve into fog. AnyGameRenderer substantially improves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, entities appear and disappear on the right frame, and fewer small entities are lost. The zero-shot base model often fails here: entities never appear, colored blocks stay unrendered, and characters appear even when they are not in the input.
blocks.zh: (2) 保持实体的通信。 游戏渲染的难点是簿记:3死时12个敌人变为9个;增援波以t=4.2 t{=}4.2 s行进;一个微小的远方暴徒不得溶解成雾. AnyGameRender大大改进了实体的通信:组数保持正确,实体出现并消失在正确的框架上,小实体损失较少. 零射基模型经常在这里失败:实体从不出现,彩色块保持不退让,字符即使不在输入中也会出现.

blocks.en: (3) Its input is plain video. Many concurrent systems rely on costly or complex representations, such as per-object class labels (StreamRender-H3, CWM), state-augmented 3D boxes (PWM), or low-poly engine proxies (Matrix-Game 4.0). AnyGameRenderer instead accepts whatever a crude game looks like, including gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic-colored maps, wireframes, and coarse clay figures, at different granularities and with one checkpoint.
blocks.zh: (3)其输入内容为纯视频. 许多并行系统依赖成本昂贵或复杂的表示,如每个对象类标签(StreamRender-H3,CWM),状态加固的3D盒(PWM),或低孔引擎代理(Matrix-Game 4.0). AnyGameRender接受任何粗糙的游戏外观,包括灰色挡板、彩色原始物、语义色彩图、线框和粗粗的粘土图,在不同的颗粒区和有一个检查站。

blocks.en: To achieve these properties, we build paired (crude video, styled video) data from three sources. (i) GEAR’s multi-stream rendering data covers 38 agent-made games, helping the model generalize across genres and input types. (ii) Two-stream rendering in Unreal Engine uses scenes scripted with same-color groups that change count mid-clip, entity sizes from 20 to 600 px, and frame-aligned appearance and disappearance, teaching the model to keep entity correspondence. (iii) Real gameplay recordings, converted into crude inputs by 3D-box detection, help the model render realistic scenes. Together they yield 10,330 training clips.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这些属性,我们从三个来源构建成对(粗糙的视频,风格的视频)数据. (一)GEAR的多流渲染数据涵盖38个代理制作的游戏,帮助模型泛泛跨流派和输入类型. (二)"不真实引擎"中的双流渲染使用同色组的脚本,将中间剪切的计数,实体大小从20px改为600px,以及帧对齐的外观和消失,教导模型保持实体通信. (三)真实的游戏剧情录音,通过3D-box检测转换成粗糙的输入,帮助模型制作出现实的场景. 总共提供了10 330个培训剪辑。

blocks.en: Existing renderers are evaluated at the frame level, with edge agreement, point tracks, or pairwise judges, which cannot tell whether each entity is rendered correctly. We therefore design an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, each annotated with ground-truth boxes, and evaluate it with four metrics. Temporal match measures whether each entity appears and disappears on time; position match measures whether it stays at the right place; unrendered rate measures how often crude input blocks are left unrendered; and hallucination rate measures how often the output contains entities that do not exist in the input. Compared with the zero-shot base, AnyGameRenderer raises temporal match from 50.9% to 62.9% and position match from 57.1% to 61.9%, and lowers the unrendered rate from 4.1% to 2.9% and the hallucination rate from 52.1% to 46.0%.
blocks.zh: 现有渲染器在框架层面进行评价,并附有边缘协议、点轨或双向判方,这些判方无法判断每个实体是否正确。 因此,我们设计了一个实体一级的基准,即59个搁置案件,有753个实体,每个实体都附有地面真实情况说明,并用4个衡量标准加以评价。 时间匹配测量每个实体是否及时出现和消失;位置匹配测量它是否停留在正确的地方;未降速度测量粗糙的输入区块被留下的未降速度;以及幻觉率测量输出包含输入中不存在的实体的频率. 与零射基相比,AnyGameRender将时间匹配率从50.9%提升至62.9%,位置匹配率从57.1%提升至61.9%,并将未降速率从4.1%降低至2.9%,幻觉率从52.1%降低至46.0%.

blocks.en: • We propose a video-to-video generative renderer for games. A single checkpoint handles a wide range of genres and input types, renders them in diverse prompted styles, and preserves entity correspondence with the input. • We build a paired dataset with three sources: multi-stream rendering data from GEAR, two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine with scenarios designed for correspondence, and detection-based reconstruction from real gameplay recordings. Together they yield 10,330 training clips. • We propose an entity-level benchmark and metrics for entity correspondence. The metrics measure whether each entity appears on time, stays in place, and is neither unrendered nor hallucinated. On this benchmark, AnyGameRenderer improves temporal match from 50.9% to 62.9% and reduces missed count changes from 34.7% to 21.3% over the zero-shot base.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出一个视频到视频 基因制作器用于游戏。 单一检查站处理各种流派和输入类型,使其具有不同的提示样式,并保留实体与输入的通信。 我们搭建了一个配对数据集,有三个来源:GEAR的多流渲染数据,Unreal Engine的双流渲染数据,以及设计用于通信的情景,以及从真实的游戏机录音中检测到的重建. • 总共制作10 330份培训短片。 我们为实体的通信提出了实体一级的基准和衡量标准。 衡量尺度衡量每个实体是否按时出现,是否留在原位上,既未放弃,也未产生幻觉。 在这个基准上,AnyGameRender将时间匹配率从50.9%提高到62.9%,并将错失的计数变化率从34.7%降至21.3%,高于零镜头基数.

blocks.en: We propose a video-to-video generative renderer for games. A single checkpoint handles a wide range of genres and input types, renders them in diverse prompted styles, and preserves entity correspondence with the input.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个视频到视频 基因制作器用于游戏。 单一的检查站处理各种流派和输入类型,使其具有不同的提示样式,并保留实体与输入的通信.

blocks.en: We build a paired dataset with three sources: multi-stream rendering data from GEAR, two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine with scenarios designed for correspondence, and detection-based reconstruction from real gameplay recordings. Together they yield 10,330 training clips.
blocks.zh: 我们搭建了一个配对数据集,有三个来源:GEAR的多流渲染数据,Unreal Engine的双流渲染数据,以及设计用于通信的情景,以及从真实的游戏机录音中检测到的重建. 总共提供了10 330个培训剪辑。

blocks.en: We propose an entity-level benchmark and metrics for entity correspondence. The metrics measure whether each entity appears on time, stays in place, and is neither unrendered nor hallucinated. On this benchmark, AnyGameRenderer improves temporal match from 50.9% to 62.9% and reduces missed count changes from 34.7% to 21.3% over the zero-shot base.
blocks.zh: 我们为实体的通信提出了实体一级的基准和衡量标准。 衡量尺度衡量每个实体是否按时出现,是否留在原位上,既未放弃,也未产生幻觉。 在这个基准上,AnyGameRender将时间匹配率从50.9%提高到62.9%,并将错失的计数变化率从34.7%降至21.3%,高于零镜头基数.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 AI-driven game creation
blocks.zh: 2.1 AI驱动的游戏创作

blocks.en: Early work uses large language models to generate game content such as levels and rules. MarioGPT [ 34 ] generates Super Mario Bros. levels from text, Word2World [ 28 ] turns stories into playable 2D tile worlds, and LLMGG [ 13 ] generates game rules and levels in the Video Game Description Language. Multi-agent frameworks such as GameGPT [ 6 ] split game development into roles that collaborate on a full project. More recently, coding agents build complete games end-to-end. Recursive Game Creator [ 7 ] iterates designer, builder, player and reviewer roles over HTML and Godot projects; OpenGame [ 17 ] is an open-source agentic framework for web games across genres such as action and tower defense; and GEAR [ 1 ] turns a short prompt into a playable game in minutes. While these systems produce working game logic, their visuals are usually limited to simple shapes and placeholder assets, far from the art quality of commercial games.
blocks.zh: 早期作品使用大型语言模型生成关卡和规则等游戏内容. MarioGPT [34] 生成 超级马里奥兄弟. 从文本的关卡,Word2World [28] 将故事变成可玩的2D瓷砖世界,LLMGG [13] 在视频游戏描述语言中生成游戏规则和关卡. GameGPT[6]等多代理框架将游戏开发分为在完整项目上合作的角色. 最近,编码代理建立完整的游戏端到端. 递归游戏创建者[7] 将HTML和Godot项目上的设计者,构建者,玩家和评论者角色;OpenGame[17]是一个跨动作和塔防等流派的网络游戏的开源代理框架;GEAR[1]在几分钟内将一个简短的提示变成一个可玩游戏. 虽然这些系统产生工作游戏逻辑,但其视觉通常仅限于简单的形状和占位资产,远远没有商业游戏的艺术质量.

blocks.en: 2.2 Interactive world models
blocks.zh: 2.2 互动世界模式

blocks.en: Another line of work replaces the game engine altogether: an autoregressive video model, conditioned on player actions, generates the next frames. Examples include Genie [ 4 , 30 , 2 ] , GameNGen [ 36 ] , Oasis [ 9 ] , MineWorld [ 11 ] , GameGen-X [ 5 ] , GameFactory [ 41 ] , Hunyuan-GameCraft [ 18 , 35 ] , the Matrix-Game line [ 12 , 37 , 10 ] , and Yume [ 25 , 24 ] . These models are strong simulators but hard to control in the ways a game needs: exact entity counts, scripted events, and rules that hold for minutes. Long-horizon memory [ 39 , 40 , 38 , 22 ] reduces drift but does not make the world programmable.
blocks.zh: 另一行的工作完全取代了游戏引擎:一个以玩家动作为条件的自旋视频模型,生成下一个帧. 例如Genie [4, 30, 2], GameNgen [36],绿洲 [ 9],MineWorld [11],GameGen-X [5],GameFactory [41],Hunyuan-GameCraft [18,35],Matrix-Game线 [12,37,10],和优美 [25,24]. 这些模型是强大的模拟器,但很难控制游戏需要的方式:精确的实体计数,脚本事件,以及维持几分钟的规则. 长视记忆[39,40,38,22]减少漂移,但并不使世界可以编程.

blocks.en: 2.3 Generative rendering for games
blocks.zh: 2.3 游戏的基因渲染

blocks.en:
A growing body of work keeps the engine in charge of game state and uses a generative model only to render pixels. Neural forward rendering from G-buffers [ 19 , 3 , 42 , 23 ] and earlier generative world renderers [ 16 , 20 ] follow this split, but require engine-exact inputs. Several concurrent systems extend it to crude inputs that a game or an agent can produce cheaply.
CWM [ 8 ] lets a coding agent maintain world state and renders a 12-class proxy video with a MiniMax-H3 LoRA. PWM [ 15 ] converts real AAA recordings into state-augmented 3D oriented boxes and renders them with a structured spatial ControlNet on a frozen backbone. Matrix-Game 4.0 [ 32 ] renders low-poly engine proxies in real time with a distilled causal DiT. StreamRender-H3 [ 29 ] streams a 13-class semantic map into video. SolarRenderer [ 33 ] trains a control LoRA on a frozen MiniMax-H3 with six types of structural video, passes them without type labels, and generalizes to structure types unseen in training; it also renders in four steps and supports streaming.
blocks.zh:
不断壮大的作品体使引擎负责游戏状态,并使用基因模型仅用于渲染像素. G-buffers [19, 3, 42, 23] 和早期基因世界渲染器 [16, 20] 遵循这种分裂,但需要引擎精确输入. 几个并行系统将其扩展至游戏或代理商可以廉价生产的粗糙输入.
CWM [8] 让一个编码代理保持世界状态,并制作带有MiniMax-H3 LoRA的12级代理视频. PWM [15] 将真实的AAA录音转换成状态的3D导向盒,使其在冷冻的骨干上带有结构化的空间控制网. matrix-Game 4.0 [32] 将低波力引擎的代词实时与蒸馏因子DiT. StreamRender-H3 [29] 流流成13级语义图成视频. SolarRender [33] 在冷冻的MiniMax-H3上训练一个控制器LORA,并配有6种结构视频,在没有类型标签的情况下通过它们,并概括到训练中看不见的结构类型;它还分四个步骤进行,支持流线.

blocks.en: AnyGameRenderer differs from these systems in three ways. First, they are demonstrated mainly on realistic third-person, driving, or a few self-built 3D scenes; our method generalizes across a wide range of genres, including tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, crowd runners, arena survival, co-op games, and shooters. Second, many of them rely on a fixed intermediate representation, while we take plain video. Third, none of them measures entity-level correspondence. Frame-level metrics barely change when a small entity is missing or a group arrives late, and edge agreement even rewards leaving crude blocks unrendered. We make correspondence, including the count, timing and position of every entity, the main target of both training data and evaluation.
blocks.zh: AnyGameRender在三个方面与这些系统不同. 首先,它们主要表现在现实的第三人称,驾驶,或几个自建的3D场景上;我们的方法概括了广泛的流派,包括塔防,自动击球手,自上而下的幸存者,回合制战斗,卡特赛车,人群跑者,竞技场生存,合作游戏,以及射手. 第二,他们中许多人依靠固定的中间代表,而我们则使用简单的视频. 第三,它们中没有一个衡量实体一级的通信。 框架级的度量衡在小实体缺失或一组人晚到时几乎不会改变,边缘协议甚至奖励让粗糙的块不到位. 我们把通信,包括每个实体的计数、时间和位置,作为培训数据和评价的主要目标。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: AnyGameRenderer treats game rendering as reference-conditioned video editing: given a crude gameplay recording (a plain reference video) and a caption saying what each crude entity stands for, it generates the same gameplay in a target style ( Figure 2 ). We design a caption schema to enforce entity correspondence ( Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: AnyGameRender将游戏渲染视为参考条件的视频编辑:给一个粗糙的游戏游戏录制(一个简单的参考视频)和一个说明每个粗糙实体代表什么的字幕,它以目标风格生成相同的游戏播放(图2). 我们设计了一个标题方案,以执行实体的通信(第3.2节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Overview of AnyGameRenderer. (a) Paired data from three sources. GEAR games use multi-stream rendering, which pairs each game render with several aligned crude streams such as blockouts and semantic maps. Unreal Engine scenes use two-stream rendering, which pairs a full render with blockouts. Real gameplay recordings are converted into blockouts by detecting 3D bounding boxes.
(b) One training sample: the crude clip is the input video <Video 1> , the target’s first frame serves as an optional anchor, and a six-segment caption defines which real entity each crude shape represents and what must be preserved.
(c) Text, <Video 1> , anchor, and noisy target tokens form one sequence for the frozen MiniMax-H3 DiT. Only the LoRA adapters on self-attention and feed-forward layers are trained, and the model renders the input gameplay in the prompted style.
blocks.zh:
图2:AnyGameRender概览。 (a) 三个来源提供的数据。 GEAR游戏使用多流渲染,将每款游戏渲染与多个对齐的粗流如阻断和语义图对齐. 不真实的引擎场景采用双流渲染法,这种渲染法将一个完整的渲染法与阻塞法配对. 真实的游戏游戏录音通过检测3D边框被转换成屏蔽.
(b) 国家 一个训练样本:粗略的片段是输入视频 " Video 1 " ,目标的第一个帧充当可选的主播,六个部分的字幕界定了每个粗糙形状所代表的实体和必须保存的内容。
(c) 文本、 " 视频1 " 、主锚和噪音目标符号构成冷冻的MiniMax-H3 DiT的序列。 只有LORA适配器在自留心和feed-forward层上进行训练,模型使输入游戏在提示风格中进行.

blocks.en: 3.1 Task setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 任务设置

blocks.en: Let V in ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 V_{\mathrm{in}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} be a crude gameplay clip and c c be a text prompt describing the target style and what each crude entity represents. AnyGameRenderer produces V out V_{\mathrm{out}} of the same length and resolution such that (i) camera, layout, and timing match V in V_{\mathrm{in}} frame by frame; (ii) every crude entity becomes its finished counterpart at the same position, apparent size, and heading, appearing and disappearing on the same frames; and (iii) appearance, including materials, lighting, character design, and environment, follows c c and an optional anchor image I a I_{\mathrm{a}} .
blocks.zh: 让 V in QQ R T × H × W × 3 V_{\mathrm{in}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} 做一个粗糙的游戏播放片段, c 做一个文字提示,描述目标样式和每个粗糙的实体代表什么. 任何 Game 渲染器生成 V出V_{\mathrm{out},长度和分辨率都相同,以至于(一) 相机,布局,以及时间在V_{\mathrm{in}}}框中与V相匹配;(二) 每个粗糙实体成为其成品对应物,位置相同,体积明显,在同一个框中出现和消失;以及(三) 外观,包括材料,照明,人物设计和环境,跟随c和可选锚像I amathrm{a}}.

blocks.en: We build on the ref2va mode of MiniMax-H3 [ 27 ] , which edits a reference video according to a text prompt. We pass the crude clip as <Video 1> and describe the target rendering in the prompt, so any crude input works. The model runs at 24 fps up to 768p. We disable the audio loss in training and discard audio at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们基于MiniMax-H3[27]的ref2va模式,根据文本提示编辑参考视频. 我们通过粗糙的片段作为<视频1>,并在即时描述目标渲染,所以任何粗糙的输入都是可行的. 该型号运行速度为24fps,最高可达768p. 我们取消了训练中的音频损失 并丢弃推断的音频

blocks.en: Each sample has three conditions: 1) the crude clip as reference video <Video 1> ; 2) a six-segment structured caption ( Section 3.2 ); and 3) an optional anchor image. During training, the anchor is the target’s first frame; at inference, it serves as a style reference or is omitted. The crude clip fixes the structure, while the caption and anchor set the style. To render the same clip in a new style, we only change the prompt or the anchor.
blocks.zh: 每个样本有三个条件: 1) 粗略的片段作为参考视频 <Video 1 > ; 2) 六块结构字幕(第3.2节); 3) 可选主播图像。 在训练期间,锚是目标的第一个框架;推论,它是一种风格参考或省略。 粗糙的片段修正结构,而标题和锚定样式. 为了让相同的片段成为新的风格,我们只改变提示或主播.

blocks.en: We train a LoRA [ 14 ] of rank 128 on all transformer blocks with the standard flow-matching objective [ 21 ] , keeping the base weights frozen. All reported results use 20-step Euler sampling on base + + LoRA.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有变压器区块上训练一个128级的LORA[14],标准流量匹配目标[21],保持基重冻结. 所有报告的结果都采用20步Euler在基准+LORA上的取样。

blocks.en: 3.2 Caption schema: the correspondence contract
blocks.zh: 3.2 说明计划:通信合同

blocks.en: We keep the base model’s six-segment format ( subject_definitions , summary , retention_analysis , detailed_description , overall_soundscape , non_diegetic_music ) and follow four rules, which we call the correspondence contract.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了基数模型的六段格式(主题_定义,摘要,保留_分析,详细_描述,整体_声景,非_digetic_music),并遵循四个规则,我们称之为函证合同.

blocks.en: Each subject is defined as the real entity, and the crude input is named as its representation, e.g., “ every blue ellipsoid in <Video 1> is one raccoon-like orchard raider, and the whole blue group is a group of identical ones .” The color-to-identity mapping is set per clip, groups are described at class level with explicit statements that they exist.
blocks.zh: 每个主体被定义为真正的实体,粗糙的输入被命名为它的表示,例如,“在<Video 1>中,每个蓝色椭圆形是一只类似浣熊的果园突袭者,整个蓝色组是一组相同的群体......”。 从颜色到身份的映射是每段剪辑设定的,分组在类级别上描述,并有明确的声明它们存在.

blocks.en: This segment declares position, apparent size, timing, and head count as preserved exactly, and leaves appearance to the prompt. It also describes empty space positively: “areas empty in <Video 1> stay empty; no character is added that has no primitive in <Video 1> .”
blocks.zh: 此段宣布位置、 明显大小、 时间和人头计数 完全保留, 并留待提示 。 它还正面描述了空地:“在<视频1>中空地保持空地;没有添加在<视频1>中没有原始字符的字符。”

blocks.en: The base model has no negative prompt, and negative phrasing tends to produce what it names (“no HUD” reliably produces a HUD). All captions are therefore written as positive statements.
blocks.zh: 底模没有负速率,负词往往产生它所命名的东西(“没有HUD”可靠地产生HUD)。 因此,所有标题都写成正面声明。

blocks.en: Captions are generated automatically from engine metadata and detection results, not written by hand. Each caption lists every character that may appear in the game, even if some never show up in the clip. We keep this noise on purpose: it teaches the model to decide what exists from the video, not from the text. As a result, the model rarely adds characters that are named in the caption but missing from the input.
blocks.zh: 说明是由引擎元数据和检测结果自动生成的,而不是用手书写. 每个标题都列出了游戏中可能出现的每一个字符,即使有些字符从未出现在剪辑中. 我们故意保留这种噪音:它教模型从视频而不是从文本中决定存在什么. 因此,模型很少添加标题中命名但输入中缺失的字符.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training recipe
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训方法

blocks.en: All sources are resampled to 124-frame clips at 24 fps (5.17 s) and 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 , with the target’s first frame as the anchor and a silent 32 kHz audio track. Latents and text embeddings are cached once per source.
blocks.zh: 所有来源在24 fps(5.17 s)和1344×768 1344\times}768 重印为124帧剪辑,目标第一帧为锚,无声32 kHz音轨.  Latents 和文本嵌入器每个源一次缓存.

blocks.en: We train a rank-128 LoRA on all blocks with a global batch size of 16. The learning rate warms up over 100 steps and then follows a cosine decay, with a peak between 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} and 2.8 × 10 − 5 2.8{\times}10^{-5} ; weight decay is 0.01. We use bf16 precision, gradient checkpointing, and block swapping, while FlashAttention-3 [ 31 ] speeds up each step by about 30%. Training runs on 16 NVIDIA H200 GPUs (141 GB). Each step takes about 129 s, and three epochs over all 10,330 training clips take about 48 hours.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有区块上训练一个128级的LORA,全球批量规模为16. 学习速度温和超过100步,然后跟随余弦衰变,峰值介于2×10−5 2×time}10×5}和2.8×10×5 2.8×time}10×5};体重衰变为0.01. 我们使用bf16精度,梯度检查,和块交换,而FlashAttention-3[31]每一步的速度大约为30%. 培训以16 NVIDIA H200 GPU(141 GB)为主。 每一步大约需要129秒,所有10,330个训练剪辑的3个纪元需要约48小时.

blocks.en: We use a LoRA multiplier of 1.0 for in-domain inputs and styles. For out-of-domain text-only styles (no anchor image, and a style unseen in training), a multiplier of 0.7 recovers the zero-shot visual quality while keeping the correspondence gains. We recommend it as the default for open-ended styling.
blocks.zh: 我们使用1.0的LORA乘数进行域内输入和样式. 对于域外文本唯一的样式(没有主播图像,训练中看不见的样式),0.7的乘数可以恢复零镜头的视觉质量,同时保持通信收益. 我们建议将它作为无限制型号的默认。

blocks.en: 4 Data
blocks.zh: 4 数据

blocks.en: We build (crude video, styled video) pairs from three sources: multi-stream rendering data from GEAR covers different genres and input types; two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine targets entity correspondence; and real gameplay recordings add realistic layouts, cameras, and motion. In every pair, the crude and styled videos share the same camera and layout and are frame-aligned by construction.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个来源构建(粗略的视频,风格化的视频)对:GEAR的多流渲染数据覆盖不同的流派和输入类型;不真实的引擎目标实体对应的双流渲染数据;以及真实的游戏机录音增加了现实的布局,摄像头,和运动. 每对镜头中,粗糙和风格化的视频共用相同的相机和布局,并且通过构造来配合帧.

blocks.en: 4.1 GEAR games
blocks.zh: 4.1 GEAR 游戏

blocks.en:
GEAR [ 1 ] is a game-creation system that builds small games end-to-end from a prompt and can export different render passes from a running game. Our multi-stream rendering data uses 38 agent-made games, covering shooters, survivors, tower defense, kart racing, arena, and co-op designs. This source contributes 3,221 clips. Each clip has five aligned passes: the target render; a primitive pass, where the scene is a gray blockout and characters are simple geometric shapes; a coarse pass, with a more detailed blockout and low-poly clay figures; a 12-class semantic map; and depth. Each clip also comes with an anchor image, a caption, and 3D boxes.
We train on the pair of primitive and target.
blocks.zh:
GEAR [1]是一个游戏创建系统,它从一个提示中构建小游戏端到端,并且可以输出运行中的游戏的不同渲染通道. 我们的多流渲染数据使用38款代理制作的游戏,涵盖射手,幸存者,塔防,kart赛车,竞技场,以及co-op设计. 这个来源提供了3,221个剪辑. 每个片段有5个对齐的通道:目标渲染;原始的通道,其中场景为灰色挡板,人物为简单的几何形状;粗糙的通道,有更详细的挡板和低孔粘土图;12级语义图;以及深度. 每个片段还附有锚定图像,字幕,以及3D盒.
我们训练的对 原始和目标。

blocks.en: 4.2 Unreal Engine
blocks.zh: 4.2 非真实引擎

blocks.en: Each Unreal Engine scene uses two-stream rendering: it is rendered from the same simulation and camera as a gray blockout with colored blocks for characters and as a full render. The protagonist is always blue, and other characters use a six-color set.
blocks.zh: 每个不真实 引擎场景使用双流渲染:它是用同样的模拟和相机做成灰色挡板,为人物配色块和作为全渲染. 主角总是蓝色的,其他角色使用六色的设定.

blocks.en: Rather than collecting generic gameplay, we script scenes around the zero-shot failures (see examples in Figure 3 ) to ensure entity correspondence: • Count changes in same-color groups. Groups of 2 to 20 characters walk in, spawn, walk out, or despawn during the clip, in dense clusters, columns, or scattered formations. This targets crowds left as unrendered blocks and entities that appear late or never. • Characters of different colors entering and leaving. This targets wrong entry and exit timing when several character types share a scene. • Entity sizes from 20 to 600 pixels , including boss-sized characters and characters moving toward or away from the camera. This targets small, distant entities that dissolve into the background. • Mixed camera views : 35% follow, 30% top-down, 20% isometric, and 15% side. This keeps the model from relying on a single viewpoint. We keep clips where the protagonist is visible in at least 95% of frames. Each clip carries metadata on the scene, characters, colors, and events, from which its caption is generated. This source contributes 3,910 clips.
blocks.zh: 我们不是收集通用的游戏游戏,而是围绕零镜头失败的脚本场景(见图3中的例子),以确保实体的对应: • 同色组中计数变化. 2到20个角色组成的团体走进,产卵,走出,或者在剪辑期间脱落,成密集的集群,柱子,或散落的阵型. 此举针对的是作为未屈服的街道和实体而留下的人群,这些街道和实体出现较晚或从未出现. • 不同颜色进出的字符。 当多个字符类型共享一个场景时,此目标错误的出入口时间. • 实体大小从20至600像素,包括老板大小的字符和向镜头移动或远离镜头的字符。 这针对的是分散在背景中的小型、遥远的实体。 • 混合摄像头视图:35%接踵而至,30%自上而下,20%同位素,15%侧。 这使得模型无法依赖单一的观点. 我们保留片段,其中主角在至少95%的帧中可见. 每个片段都带有场景上的元数据,人物,颜色,以及事件,从中生成其标题. 这个来源提供了3,910个剪辑.

blocks.en: Count changes in same-color groups. Groups of 2 to 20 characters walk in, spawn, walk out, or despawn during the clip, in dense clusters, columns, or scattered formations. This targets crowds left as unrendered blocks and entities that appear late or never.
blocks.zh: 同色组数变化. 2到20个角色组成的团体走进,产卵,走出,或者在剪辑期间脱落,成密集的集群,柱子,或散落的阵型. 此举针对的是作为未屈服的街道和实体而留下的人群,这些街道和实体出现较晚或从未出现.

blocks.en: Characters of different colors entering and leaving. This targets wrong entry and exit timing when several character types share a scene.
blocks.zh: 不同颜色的字符进入和离开。 当多个字符类型共享一个场景时,此目标错误的出入口时间.

blocks.en: Entity sizes from 20 to 600 pixels , including boss-sized characters and characters moving toward or away from the camera. This targets small, distant entities that dissolve into the background.
blocks.zh: 实体大小从20到600像素, 包括老板大小的字符和字符向着或离开相机。 这针对的是分散在背景中的小型、遥远的实体。

blocks.en: Mixed camera views : 35% follow, 30% top-down, 20% isometric, and 15% side. This keeps the model from relying on a single viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 混合摄像头视线:35%后,30%后,20%后,15%后。 这使得模型无法依赖单一的观点.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Three failures of the zero-shot base model. Red dashed boxes mark the errors. Left: input primitives are left unrendered; the cyan cylinders stay in the output instead of becoming characters. Middle: the input has only two blocks, but the model adds an extra creature that does not exist in the input. Right: the input is a top-down view, but the model renders a frontal group shot.
blocks.zh: 图3:零射基模型三次失败. 红色破碎的盒子标记错误。 左侧:输入原始字未交;青色圆柱留在输出中而不是成为字符. 中间:输入只有两个块,但模型增加了一个在输入中不存在的额外生物. 对:输入是自上而下的视图,但模型使正面组拍.

blocks.en: 4.3 Real gameplay recordings
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 真正的游戏录音

blocks.en: Following the reconstruction approach in PWM [ 15 ] , we convert real gameplay recordings of combat, driving, and pedestrian scenes into crude inputs. We detect 3D bounding boxes in each frame and render them over a checkerboard ground as proxies of varied shapes: solid boxes, wireframe boxes, cylinders, and upright ellipsoids, with about 800 clips per shape. The original recording is the target, and captions come from the detection labels plus one sentence describing the environment. This source adds real-world scenes, with realistic camera work and vehicle and pedestrian motion. It contributes 3,199 clips.
blocks.zh: 遵循PWM[15]中的重建方式,我们将战斗,驾驶,以及行人场景的真实游戏录音转换成粗糙的输入. 我们探测到每个框中的3D边框,并在一个检查板的地面上将它们制成不同形状的代名词:固体盒、线框盒、圆柱和直立椭圆形,每个形状约有800个夹片。 最初的录音是目标,字幕来自检测标签加上描述环境的一句话. 这个来源增加了现实世界的场景,有现实主义的摄影作品以及车辆和行人运动. 它提供了3,199个剪辑。

blocks.en: The three sources are mixed at roughly equal weight ( Table 1 ), giving 10,330 clips of 124 frames, about 14.8 hours of paired video.
blocks.zh: 三个来源的混合量大致相等(表1),给出了10,330个124帧的片段,约14.8小时的配对视频.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Training data mixture. All clips are 124 frames at 24 fps and 1344 × 768 1344{\times}768 , with captions generated from each source’s metadata.
blocks.zh: 表1:培训数据混合物。 所有剪辑都是124帧的24 fps和1344 × 768 1344\times}768, 标题来自每个源的元数据。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Entity-sync results (%) on the held-out benchmark : four main metrics (left) and three secondary statistics (right). GT floor (gray) runs the ground-truth RGB video through the same detection and matching pipeline.
blocks.zh: 表2:实体同步结果(%),所持基准:四个主要指标(左)和三个二级统计(右)。 GT地板(gray)通过同一探测和匹配的管道运行地面真实的RGB视频.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We first describe the evaluation protocol ( Section 5.1 ), then evaluate entity correspondence ( Section 5.2 ) and generalization across genres ( Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述评价协议(第5.1节),然后评价实体的函证(第5.2节)和跨流派的概括(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价协议

blocks.en: The benchmark contains 59 cases with 753 annotated entities: 11 held-out two-stream rendering cases from Unreal Engine (gray blockouts), 14 real recordings with detected solid boxes, and 34 multi-stream rendering cases from GEAR across 6 held-out games. Each case uses a source clip excluded from training, rendered in a style or with characters not seen in training. All models are run with the same seed, 20 sampling steps, and the same captions.
blocks.zh: 该基准包含59个案例,有753个注解实体:11个来自不真实引擎的截断双流渲染案例(Gray blockout),14个真实录音带检测到的固态盒,34个来自GEAR的多流渲染案例覆盖6个搁置游戏. 每起案件都使用一个被排除在培训之外的源片段,以一种风格制作,或带有培训中看不到的人物。 所有模型都使用相同的种子,20个采样步骤和相同的标题运行.

blocks.en: Input entities are the ground-truth 2D boxes shipped with each crude video; entities that exist for fewer than 12 frames are ignored. In the generated video, we locate characters with SAM3 open-vocabulary segmentation, prompted with the caption’s subject phrases plus generic person and vehicle terms. We remove shadow and reflection detections and link the remaining detections into tracks. In each frame, input boxes and detections are matched with the Hungarian method, and a pair is accepted only if IoU ≥ 0.3 {}\geq 0.3 or the centroid offset is within half the input box size. We report four main metrics, averaged over entities: • Temporal match : the IoU between the frames in which an entity exists in the input and the frames in which its track is in place. Late or missing appearance, lingering after despawn, and identity swaps all lower it. • Position match : 1 − d / ( 0.5 ​ s ) 1-d/(0.5\,s) on matched frames, where d d is the centroid offset and s s is the input box size. • Unrendered rate : the fraction of entity-frames in which the input block is still visible as a flat color patch. • Hallucination rate : the fraction of detected entity-frames that belong to tracks matching no input entity. We also report three secondary statistics: • On-time appearance : an entity is recognized at the first frame t t where it is matched in both t t and t + 1 t{+}1 , giving an onset delay Δ on = t − t in \Delta_{\mathrm{on}}=t-t_{\mathrm{in}} , where t in t_{\mathrm{in}} is its first frame in the input. An entity is on time if | Δ on | ≤ 4 |\Delta_{\mathrm{on}}|\leq 4 frames ( ≈ 0.17 {\approx}0.17 s). • Never appears : the fraction of entities that are never recognized. • Missed count changes : a count change is a rise of at least two entities in the input within six frames, n in ​ [ t + 3 ] − n in ​ [ t − 3 ] ≥ 2 n_{\mathrm{in}}[t{+}3]-n_{\mathrm{in}}[t{-}3]\geq 2 , with target count n in ​ [ t + 8 ] n_{\mathrm{in}}[t{+}8] . It is reproduced if, within the next 60 frames, the detected count stays at or above the target minus one for three consecutive frames. We report the fraction of the 75 count changes in the benchmark that are missed. The GT floor in Table 2 runs the ground-truth RGB video through the same pipeline and marks the best score the pipeline can measure.

blocks.en: 5.2 Entity correspondence
blocks.zh: 5.2 实体函件

blocks.en: Table 2 reports results on all 59 cases and on each source. Over all cases, our method improves all four main metrics: temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, position match from 57.1% to 61.9%, the unrendered rate falls from 4.1% to 2.9%, and the hallucination rate falls from 52.1% to 46.0%. The secondary statistics show the same trend. On-time appearance rises from 55.9% to 67.6%, entities that never appear fall from 26.0% to 20.2%, and missed count changes fall from 34.7% to 21.3%.
blocks.zh: 表2报告所有59个案件和每个来源。 在所有情况下,我们的方法都改善了所有四个主要衡量标准:时间匹配率从50.9%上升到62.9%,位置匹配率从57.1%下降到61.9%,未降温率从4.1%下降到2.9%,幻觉率从52.1%下降到46.0%。 二级统计也显示出同样的趋势。 现时出场率从55.9%上升到67.6%,从未出场的实体从26.0%下降到20.2%,错过的点数变化从34.7%下降到21.3%。

blocks.en: Gains differ by source. On GEAR’s multi-stream rendering cases, temporal match rises by 13 points and missed count changes nearly halve. On Unreal Engine’s two-stream rendering cases, temporal match reaches 96.6%, close to the GT floor of 98.5%, and no entity is missed. Real recordings improve the least: temporal match rises from 46.5% to 51.1%, the unrendered rate is similar, and missed count changes stay at 20.0%.
blocks.zh: 收益因来源而异。 在GEAR的多流渲染案例上,时间匹配上升了13分,错过了将近一半的计数变化. 在不真实引擎的两流渲染案例中,时间匹配率达到96.6%,接近98.5%的GT底,没有漏掉任何实体. 真实录制改善最少:时间匹配率从46.5%上升到51.1%,未交接率相似,错失的计数变化保持在20.0%.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows seven held-out cases. The zero-shot model works well on sparse scenes with clean captions, but on game footage it fails in three ways. First, it leaves crude shapes in the output: blue cubes in an orchard, cyan cylinders in an arena, and a blue cylinder in the grass where an elk should be. Second, it drops the input viewpoint when the style is far from typical game footage, turning a top-down blockout into a frontal anime group shot or a first-person Minecraft-like scene. Third, it adds characters named in the caption that have no block in the input. AnyGameRenderer fixes all three in these cases while keeping the prompted style.
blocks.zh: 图4显示7个搁置案件。 零镜头模式在带干净字幕的稀少场景上效果良好,但在游戏镜头上则以三种方式失败. 首先,它会在输出中留下粗糙的形状:果园中的蓝色立方体,竞技场中的青色圆柱体,草丛中的蓝色圆柱体应该有一只麋鹿. 其次,当风格与典型的游戏镜头相去甚远时,它会降低输入视角,将一个自上而下的屏蔽变成前置动画组镜头或第一人称Minecraft类似场景. 第三,它添加在标题中命名的字符,这些字符在输入中没有块. AnyGameRender在保持提示样式的同时,将这三种情形全部修复.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Zero-shot MiniMax-H3 versus AnyGameRenderer on held-out cases , with the same seed, steps, and caption. The zero-shot model leaves crude shapes unrendered (rows 1–4), drops the input viewpoint for out-of-domain styles (rows 5–6: a top-down blockout becomes a frontal anime scene or a first-person voxel scene), and adds caption-named characters although the input has only two blocks (row 7). AnyGameRenderer fixes all three. For rows 5–6, the “GT” column is the original in-domain render and serves only as a layout reference.
blocks.zh: 图4:在悬案上0射入的MiniMax-H3对AnyGameRender ,种子,阶梯和标题相同. 零镜头模型留下粗糙的外形未交接(第1至4行),对域外样式放下输入视角(第5至6行:自上而下的屏蔽变为前置动画场景或第一人称的 voxel 场景),并添加标题字符,尽管输入只有两个块(第7行). 任何GameRender 修复所有三个。 对于第5至第6行, " GT " 栏是原始的域内渲染,仅作为布局参考。

blocks.en: 5.3 Generalization across genres
blocks.zh: 5.3 跨流派的概括

blocks.en: A single checkpoint handles all five genres in our benchmark: first-person shooters, top-down, third-person, crowd, and vehicle games ( Figure 5 ). AnyGameRenderer improves temporal match over the zero-shot model in every genre, with the largest gains on crowd and third-person games. It also lowers the unrendered rate in every genre except crowd games, where both models are already near zero, and improves position match most on vehicle games. The hallucination rate falls on crowd games but rises slightly on top-down and third-person games. Top-down games remain the hardest, with low temporal match for both models.
blocks.zh: 一个检查站处理我们基准中所有五个流派:第一人称射击手,自上而下,第三人称,人群,以及车辆游戏(图5). AnyGameRender在每一个流派中比零镜头模型改进时间匹配,在人群和第三人称游戏上收获最大. 这也降低了每个流派中除人群游戏外的未降级率,这两个型号都已经接近零,并且改善了车辆游戏中位置最匹配的. 幻觉率在人群游戏上下降,但在自上而下和第三人称游戏上略有上升. 自上而下游戏仍然是最难的,两种模式的时间匹配率都很低.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Entity-sync metrics by genre. Zero-shot MiniMax-H3 (orange) versus AnyGameRenderer (blue) on the held-out benchmark, grouped into first-person shooter, top-down, third-person, crowd, and vehicle games.
blocks.zh: 图5:按流派分列的实体同步计量。 0镜头的MiniMax-H3(Orange)与AnyGameRender(蓝色)在被搁置的基准上,分为第一人称射击,自上而下,第三人称,人群,以及车辆游戏.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns the programmer art of agent-made games into high-quality visuals. We train a single LoRA on MiniMax-H3, using paired data from GEAR’s multi-stream rendering, Unreal Engine’s two-stream rendering, and real gameplay recordings. The resulting checkpoint handles a wide range of genres. It takes plain video as input, from gray blockouts and colored primitives to semantic maps and wireframes. It also keeps entities in sync with the input. On a held-out benchmark, temporal match rises from 50.9% to 62.9%, and missed count changes fall from 34.7% to 21.3%. As coding agents build more and more games, we believe a general renderer that keeps every entity in place will help these games look as good as they play.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了AnyGameRenderer,一个视频到视频的基因渲染器,将代理游戏的程序员艺术转化为高质量的视觉. 我们利用GEAR的多流渲染、不真实引擎的两流渲染以及真实的游戏游戏录制数据,在MiniMax-H3上培训一个单一的LORA。 由此形成的检查站处理各种流派. 它以简单的视频作为输入,从灰色屏蔽和彩色原始到语义地图和线框. 它还使实体与输入同步. 在搁置基准上,时间匹配率从50.9%上升到62.9%,错过的计数变化从34.7%下降到21.3%。 随着编码代理制作越来越多的游戏,我们相信让每个实体保持原位的通用渲染器会帮助这些游戏看起来和游戏玩法一样好.
